Inyathelo 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.

20261122-chemistry-g06-2.title: Iiasidi neealkali
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Iiasidi neealkali ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.material: [E6 Uphando Lwekhemistri (Phambili)] Ingxaki yohlalutyo lobungakanani malunga ne-Iiasidi neealkali. Isisombululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kwaye isisombululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaphi ukuxinana kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.prompt: [E6 Uphando Lwekhemistri (Phambili)] Ingxaki yohlalutyo lobungakanani malunga ne-Iiasidi neealkali. Isisombululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kwaye isisombululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaphi ukuxinana kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Inyathelo 2: Umlinganiselo $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Inyathelo 3: Ukuxinana kuka-$A$ kukhulu ngokuphindwe ka-100 kune-B.
